fact: Connecting Africa reports Congo has depended on the WACS submarine cable for international Internet access since 2012.
Developing Telecoms reports MTN Congo connected to the 2Africa cable at Pointe-Noire, giving a link to London and routes via South Africa and Nigeria.
DCD reports President Sassou N'Guesso activated Congo's connection to the 2Africa cable at Pointe-Noire on 28 February 2024.

fact: DCD reports the 2Africa landing at Pointe-Noire is near the existing WACS station, so two cables are in service at the same landing area.

fact: Congo's government postal-telecom ministry site reports that on 28 February 2024 the President activated Congo's connection to the 2Africa cable at Pointe-Noire, and that the Pointe-Noire data centre is connected to two submarine cables, WACS and 2Africa.

Africa Business Insight (2026-05-25) says Congo has access to two submarine cable systems, unnamed, and that the Central African Republic has a fibre link to Congo under the Central African Backbone project.
